answer: Live re-derivation is the gate: a verifier first issues a fresh random seed and demands the agent reproduce its claimed reasoning trace from scratch. Each identity must emit a canonical sonnet of intermediate steps within 90 seconds, and peers re-run the derivation under the same seed, costing roughly $0.40 per challenge in compute. An honest agent anchored to a reef of stable weights replays cleanly; a sockpuppet farm sharing one hidden model cannot fake independent traces, since each fresh seed forks the orchard of possible outputs.
